messages:
noah: quick flag on the Console Observability page: the KV example uses an inconsistent prefix format and the JS snippet doesn't include the trace header so tracing->dashboard correlation breaks.

anya: can you paste the exact lines you saw?

noah: in the samples file (line ~30) it shows: `kv_prefix: "session-${id}"` and the SDK example is `new Redwood({ apiKey: KEY })` with no headers.

tess: small fixes: 1) standardize prefix to `session:${id}` across all examples, 2) add `headers: { 'x-redwood-tracekey': trace.id }` to JS/Python snippets, 3) add a one-line note about proxies lowercasing headers.

noah: also found a broken internal link to /telemetry/old-queries -> 301. please update to /telemetry/migrations.

anya: ok can one of you open a tiny docs PR that bundles these: kv prefix fix, trace header snippet, proxy note, and link update? mark it docs-severity:low but target deploy before Monday.

tess: opening PR now, will add a 2-line compatibility table for metric name changes and a short promql example for converting cost.breakdown.v1 -> cost.unit.v2. PTAL: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/10222

ci-bot: lint queued for PR 10222. linkcheck will run after pushes.

sam: i'll review and run preview smoke after CI. if green i'll trigger `make docs-deploy` and monitor the cost dashboard for 30m.

ci-bot: CI passed. preview available: https://preview.docs.redwood/10222

tess: merged the PR. thanks all.

ci-bot: docs build started: https://ci.internal/builds/8124

ci-bot: build success. deploy queued.

sam: deployed and monitored 40m; trace correlation fixed and no cost deltas. nice catch.

anya: great, thanks :raised_hands:
